74850: Tamako is a first-year in high school whose family runs a mochi shop in their town's shopping district called Tama-ya. She enjoys her high school life and the baton club with her friends Kanna and Midori. She helps her family run the shop and invent new kinds of mochi.
75080: Midori is Tamako's classmate, childhood friend, and baton club member. Her grandparents, whom she lives with, own and run a toy shop in the town's shopping district. Midori feels the need to "take care" of Tamako, so much that she feels she may be in love with her.
75082: Kanna is a high school student in the same year as her friends, Tamako and Midori, and is a member of the baton club. She is the daughter of a carpenter who works in the same shopping district as Tamako and her family.
75184: Anko is Tamako's younger sister who is in fourth grade. She is less practical than her older sister​ and is a more fashion-conscious girl.
75186: Mochizou is Tamako's childhood friend whose family runs Ouji-ya, a mochi shop located across from Tama-ya. Though their fathers are not on good terms due to business competition, he and Tamako are good friends. He is in love with Tamako.
75188: Shiori is one of Tamako's classmates and a member of the badminton club. She is a knowledgeable and resourceful girl, with a serious, cool personality.
75412: Tamako's father who runs the family's mochi shop.
75414: Tamako's grandfather who lives with her family and helps run the mochi shop.
75416: Mochizou's father who runs the Oujiya shop.
75418: Mochizou's mother who helps run the Oujiya shop.
76058: The prince of the southern island Dela journeyed from.
76060: A fortune teller from the tropical place that Dera comes from who is sent to stay with Tamako to check up on Dera.
76979: Dera Mochimazzi is a bird that speaks in Japanese, with a little bossy tone. It seems that he is a noble bird that came from a tropical place. He later stays at Tamako's house.
78221: Mamedai Kitashirakawa's wife and Tamako and Anko's late mother.
